q-84938.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14249342/assets/2a69b06fdf2997514ed4ba507461010725d0b453aaa56f0e0c87f901ee7fa466.png)

What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
q-84938.worked_solution:
The vertex of an upward-opening parabola is the lowest point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14249342/assets/7b402346a77c6c52467fda2d7f488d123f9551c18cb06cac96765bda3c4b99d7.png)

  

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(0,0).$

Question 1
?

What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?

a
(2,0)
b
(2,2)
c
(0,−2)
d
(0,0)
e
(0,2)
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The vertex of an upward-opening parabola is the lowest point of the parabola.

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are (0,0).

What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
q-84949.worked_solution:
The vertex of a left-opening parabola is the right-most point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14249342/assets/e4018ea79601a725ad4586eda123eaa5900a171bbce505c4c58c3bf80af7e6a8.png)

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(-1,-3).$

a
(−1,−1)
b
(3,1)
c
(0,−3)
d
(−1,−3)
e
(0,−1)
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

The vertex of a left-opening parabola is the right-most point of the parabola.

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are (−1,−3).
